Romantic Warrior (#1) won from midfield, defeating Numbers by 1/2 with Deep Monster third at SP 1.1. Forgive: Gentlemen Legacy (P8) wide no cover; Cap Ferrat (P9) wide no cover.

horses.incident_text: J McDonald was found guilty of a careless riding charge for causing interference near the 200 Metres (see DEEP MONSTER).  Sent for sampling post-race.

K C Leung stated that the instructions were to endeavour to find cover behind the expected leader ROMANTIC THOR.  Trainer F C Lor confirmed the instructions and stated that he issued those instructions to attempt to have the horse run out a strong 2400 Metres.  He added NUMBERS raced too keenly and as a result was unable to obtain cover.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Throughout the early and middle stages raced keenly.  The Stewards deferred the declaration of weighed-in as they were of the opinion that an incident occurred for some distance approaching the 200 Metres which cast doubt on whether ROMANTIC WARRIOR (J McDonald) should be declared the winner due to interference suffered by DEEP MONSTER.  When Jockey Moreira and the connections of DEEP MONSTER did not lodge a protest/objection and the Stewards were satisfied, having regard to the 2 lengths margin between ROMANTIC WARRIOR and DEEP MONSTER, that there were not sufficient grounds to do so, weighed-in was declared on the numbers semaphored by the Judge.  At a subsequent inquiry, J McDonald was found guilty of a charge of careless riding [Rule 100(1)] in that near the 300 Metres he directed his mount in when not clear of DEEP MONSTER, resulting in DEEP MONSTER being taken from its rightful running, further resulting in DEEP MONSTER being checked to avoid NUMBERS near the 200 Metres, causing DEEP MONSTER to shift out and make heavy contact with ROMANTIC WARRIOR.  J McDonald was suspended from riding in races for a period to commence on Wednesday, 3 June 2026 and to expire on Thursday, 11 June 2026 on which day he may resume race riding (3 Hong Kong racedays).  In addition, Jockey McDonald was fined $120,000.  In assessing penalty, the Stewards determined the carelessness grade 3 and the consequences grade 2.

Near the 450 Metres COMET MAJESTY, which hung out, was checked to avoid FLYING FORTRESS (H Bowman) which shifted in slightly and ALMIGHTY LIGHTNING (A Atzeni) which, after shifting to the outside of MY MARS (B Avdulla), was taken out by MY MARS.  After considering the evidence the Stewards advised Jockeys Bowman, Atzeni and Avdulla to exercise more care in similar circumstances.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Made contact with the left side of its starting gate on jumping and lost ground.  Near the 300 Metres was bumped heavily by TITAN PEGASUS which shifted out when being checked.  Near the 150 Metres was checked when crowded between ELITE GOLF (H Bentley)  which shifted out slightly and SUGAR SUGAR (J Moreira) which improved to the inside of FLYING FORTRESS (H Bowman) as that runner commenced to give ground and shift in slightly.  Jockeys Bentley, Moreira and Bowman were all advised to exercise more care in similar circumstances.  STAR RISE then could not be ridden out to the finish of the event when held up behind SUGAR SUGAR.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.  Sent for sampling post-race.

When questioned regarding his riding in the early stages of the Home Straight E Brown stated that after being held up behind ELITE GOLF, he shifted to the outside of ELITE GOLF near the 400 Metres, but he was reluctant to continue to shift out as he identified calls from a number of riders to his outside.  He said for this reason he commenced cautiously to shift to the outside of VIGOR HAPPINESS and as he did so he was then prevented from shifting out further when STAR RISE improved to his outside.  He said as a consequence he was then obliged to check to avoid VIGOR HAPPINESS near the 300 Metres when that runner gave ground quickly, resulting in his mount shifting out and making contact with STAR RISE.

Jumped awkwardly.  Raced keenly in the early and middle stages.  H T Mo reported that his mount made a respiratory noise during the event.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.

races.narrative: Race 11: STANDARD CHARTERED SME BANKING HANDICAP — 1400m, Class 3, going GF. Early lead: Golden Champ, Akashvani. The Red Hare (#6) won from midfield, defeating Without Compare by 1-1/4 with Fit For Beauty third at SP 13. Veterinary: Thunder Blaze (PNone) — needs to pass vet exam before racing again. Forgive: Victor The Rapid (P10) wide no cover; Class (P12) wide no cover; Continent Express (P13) wide no cover.

horses.incident_text: Shifted out shortly after the start and made contact with VICTOR THE RAPID.  Sent for sampling post-race.
Sent for sampling post-race.
Approaching the 400 Metres was shifted to the outside of VICTOR THE RAPID to improve and as a result made contact with CONTINENT EXPRESS which was hampered and taken wider.
Noted to have blood in the mouth on arrival at the Start, was examined by the Veterinary Officer and passed suitable to race.  Jumped only fairly.  Sent for sampling post-race.

Bumped shortly after the start.  Near the 400 Metres was hampered when taken wider.  Near the 1000 Metres improved to the inside of FIT FOR BEAUTY and was steadied when FIT FOR BEAUTY shifted in slightly.
No report.
Slow to begin.

B Avdulla reported that he was obliged to make use of his mount in the early stages to hold a position outside the  lead.  He said as a result AKASHVANI was unable to finish the race off in the Home Straight under its top weight of 135 lbs.  A veterinary inspection immediately following the race did not show any significant findings.
No report.
Shortly after the start was crowded between CLASS and THE RED HARE which shifted out.

On jumping was crowded between CALIFORNIA WAVES and CONTINENT EXPRESS which shifted in.  Near the 1100 Metres improved to the inside of CALIFORNIA WAVES as CALIFORNIA WAVES improved to the inside of FIT FOR BEAUTY.  When FIT FOR BEAUTY then shifted in slightly CALIFORNIA WAVES was taken in, resulting in CHARMING LEGEND having to be steadied.  Near the 400 Metres was hampered when taken wider.
Bumped shortly after the start.

Jumped awkwardly, shifted in and made contact with CHARMING LEGEND.  Near the 400 Metres was bumped by FIT FOR BEAUTY and taken wider by that runner.  Raced wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

Became fractious in the starting gates and got its right hind leg caught on the barrier partition for some time.  Was removed from the barriers, examined by the Veterinary Officer and found to be lame in its right hind leg.  Was withdrawn by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice.  Before being allowed to race again, PRIME SUCCESS will be required to perform satisfactorily in a barrier trial and be subjected to an official veterinary examination.

horses.short: Must pass veterinary exam before racing again
horses.incident_text: Withdrawn on 23.5.26 by order of the Stewards acting on veterinary advice (lame right fore) and replaced by Standby Declared Starter CLASS.  Before being allowed to race again, THUNDER BLAZE will be subjected to an official veterinary examination.
